mapper.sql: id, code, order_resource, customer_id, user_id, special_requirements, discount_amount, receive_address_id, receive_address, third_platform_id, third_platform_order_code, guanjiapo_code, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted, delivery_date, order_money, sync_status, sync_fail_reason, currency, tax, fob, exw, exchange_rate, contract_number
mapper.select:
SELECT so.id, so.code, so.order_resource as orderResource, so.customer_id as customerId, IFNULL(sc.name, so.customer_name) as customerName, so.user_id as userId, so.special_requirements as specialRequirements, so.discount_amount as discountAmount, so.salesman_id as salesmanId, su_salesman.nick_name as salesmanName, su_follower.nick_name as followerName, so.receive_address_id as receiveAddressId, so.receive_address as receiveAddress, so.third_platform_id as thirdPlatformId, so.create_user as createUser, so.create_time as createTime, so.update_user as updateUser, so.update_time as updateTime, so.delivery_date as deliveryTime, so.order_money as orderMoney, so.third_platform_order_code as thirdPlatformOrderCode, so.sync_status as syncStatus, so.sync_fail_reason as syncFailReason, so.guanjiapo_code as guanjiapoCode, so.currency as currency, so.tax as tax, so.fob as fob, so.exw as exw, so.exchange_rate as exchangeRate, so.contract_number as contractNumber FROM sal_sed_order so LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer sc ON so.customer_id = sc.id AND sc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su_salesman ON so.salesman_id = su_salesman.user_id AND su_salesman.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su_follower ON so.user_id = su_follower.user_id AND su_follower.is_deleted = 0 WHERE so.is_deleted = 0
AND so.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%')
AND ( so.customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM sal_yt_customer WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%') AND is_deleted = 0) OR so.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%') )
AND so.order_resource LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderResource}, '%')
AND so.create_time >= #{startTime}
AND so.create_time <= #{endTime}
ORDER BY so.create_time DESC

SELECT so.id, so.code, so.order_resource as orderResource, so.customer_id as customerId, IFNULL(sc.name, so.customer_name) as customerName, so.user_id as userId, so.special_requirements as specialRequirements, so.discount_amount as discountAmount, so.salesman_id as salesmanId, so.receive_address_id as receiveAddressId, so.receive_address as receiveAddress, so.third_platform_id as thirdPlatformId, so.create_user as createUser, so.create_time as createTime, so.update_user as updateUser, so.update_time as updateTime, so.delivery_date as deliveryTime, so.order_money as orderMoney, so.third_platform_order_code as thirdPlatformOrderCode, so.sync_status as syncStatus, so.sync_fail_reason as syncFailReason, so.guanjiapo_code as guanjiapoCode, so.currency as currency, so.tax as tax, so.fob as fob, so.exw as exw, so.exchange_rate as exchangeRate, so.contract_number as contractNumber FROM sal_sed_order so LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer sc ON so.customer_id = sc.id AND sc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE so.id = #{id} AND so.is_deleted = 0
